steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The hoplite phalanx was the dominant Greek fighting formation: a dense line of heavily armed infantry fighting shoulder to shoulder

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Each hoplite carried an aspis (large round shield), dory (long spear), Corinthian helmet, bronze cuirass and greaves

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The phalanx's strength lay in solidarity: each man's shield protected his neighbour's right side, creating an interdependent wall

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Naval warfare became crucial after the Persian Wars; the trireme (three-banked oared warship) was the standard warship
